items.title: BB calls for curbing loan-based money laundering
items.description: The Bangladesh Bank has called on finance companies to strengthen oversight and risk-based management to tackle anonymous loans, loan-based money laundering, diversion of loan funds and related-party transactions.

items.title: BRAC Bank completes blockchain-based export deal
items.description: BRAC Bank has completed Bangladesh’s first blockchain-based digital export transaction, cutting document processing time from 40 days to just one day in a deal involving a local garment exporter and a UK retailer.

items.title: Islami Bank to raise authorised capital to Tk 10,000cr
items.description: Islami Bank Bangladesh plans to raise its authorised capital to Tk 10,000 crore from Tk 2,000 crore, the shariah-based lender said yesterday.

items.title: AI adoption not enough, value creation is key: experts
items.description: Bangladesh must focus on creating economic value from artificial intelligence (AI) rather than simply adopting the technology, experts said at the Bangladesh AI Business Summit 2026 yesterday.

items.title: Bank Asia reports 34% rise in Jan-Sept profit
items.description: Bank Asia PLC reported a 34 percent year-on-year increase in net profit to Tk 472 crore in January-September 2026, driven by higher operating cash flow, underpinned largely by strong growth in customer deposits.
